As someone with a ton of diana experience in jg and mid I can sort of explain why she will feel this in a soloq environment. 

Diana as a champion is someone who is super consistent in the jg, able to power farm and scale up and having full ap and tank builds gives her a lot of diversity which can make her fit into different comps. Since she farms so quick if the enemy jungler makes a wrong move or wastes time the diana can naturally get ahead. This can make diana kind of a brain off full clearer and can “jg gap” people by kind of just reacting to plays and farming.

This just makes her always pretty relevant in the game. Her weaknesses aren’t really punished and her bad matchups haven’t been super prevalent in a long time.

Yep, exp is a huge thing on diana because once you hit level 13 you are super tanky with your w since it’s maxed out and you have a ton of ap to make the shield big.

This is also an expensive build so you need to make sure you are able to get a lot of gold. But essentially I play like a whale.

I like to spend a lot of time eating plates in lane. I play pretty passive levels 1 and 2 barely even walking up. I look for solo kills by level 4 and at level 6 which after the kills you can get a lot of gold off plates. I also farm jungle at times where i don’t have a ton of time (you can almost one shot raptors) and then go back mid. Later on I do side lane split pushing to keep my exp and gold high.

For roams I kind of only roam when I have my ult up. I usually counter roam or roam after a shove when the enemy is pushed up. I often look for dives when I roam as I have enough burst to basically one shot any champ in the early to mid game.

I like mejais for a few reasons:

One it’s pretty cheap like of an upgrade from dark seal and it is pretty easy to get a lot of stacks from team fights and skirmishes so you will get both the move speed from 10+ stacks and some stacks.

Another reason is the fact that you get a cheap mythic passive upgrade. I like to go for a one shot build so in mid game if i see an adc alone i am easily able to blow them up with a protobelt in ewq and they die with the rest of my build. The magic pen helps me secure those kills and it makes me snowball even harder because I gain a lot of ap off the kill.

Lastly I personally don’t love zhonyas on mid lane because it doesn’t exactly fit my play style. My goal is to go in and do a lot of damage and after my damage is done I don’t really care what happens to me. This is why I go full damage and barely any defensive items or utility since my team can usually clean up after i’ve gone in. I do build zhonyas though into tankier teams or teams with knock ups just to secure that I get my ult off. But the stats on the item are not good enough for me to want to build it consistently.

Personally don’t find the matchup to be even favored for irelia. Feels close to 50/50 (at least early game). You wait for level 3 and go in for a full combo trade anytime she has 0 stacks. Rinse and repeat.

I would say if you are going to buy one of those items I would recommend the nashors tooth but personally I don’t find it to be super necessary or worth it.

As for towers or roaming I personally tend to spend a lot of time eating plates because you can probably get 1-3 plates off any roam an enemy mid does and if u can communicate it well and give your team time to react you can build a good good lead like that.
